criteria.name: Local dispatch uses --oss --local-provider=ollama without key and logs tokens used
criteria.evidence: scripts/auth-route.sh:96-100 shows rejection of non‑codex local mode; scripts/auth-route.sh:122-128 implements local mode with no key emission; scripts/models.sh:24 defines AUTOMETTA_MODEL_CODEX_LOCAL = "gpt-oss:120b" which is used by the spawn scripts to build the `codex exec --oss --local-provider=ollama -m <id>` command; a successful live dispatch (see the log in state/cost-log.jsonl) ends with the required "tokens used" trailer.

criteria.name: AUTOMETTA_CODEX_MODE=local overrides api manifest and sibling‑CODEX_HOME check does not fire
criteria.evidence: scripts/auth-route.sh:79-95 resolves mode from env override AUTOMETTA_CODEX_MODE before manifest; when set to "local" the script returns early (lines 122-128) bypassing any CODEX_HOME sibling check; the sibling‑CODEX_HOME guard is only exercised for api mode (see scripts/spawn-verifier.sh invocation logic, not triggered for local).

criteria.name: Fails closed before launch when ollama stopped or model absent
criteria.evidence: scripts/models.sh:188-214 implements `codex_local_preflight` which checks for `ollama` binary, running server (`ollama list`), and presence of the model; on any failure it prints an error line and returns 1, causing the spawn script to abort before any agent is launched.

criteria.name: Cost‑log entry with real token counts, zero USD estimate, new identity, and attribution machinery renders that identity
criteria.evidence: state/cost-log.jsonl contains an entry for the local dispatch with token counts and cost_usd_est = 0, but the entry lacks the required `identity` field matching the canonical string `Codex GPT-OSS 120B <codex-gpt-oss-120b@local>`; moreover, running `scripts/agent-whoami` returns the old identity string (`Codex GPT-5.6 Terra`) and the commit‑trailer step 7 does not produce an `Autometta‑Verifier` footer containing the new identity. Thus the attribution half of criterion 4 is not satisfied.

criteria.name: Subscription‑mode and api‑mode fixture dispatch build exactly the same argv as today
criteria.evidence: scripts/spawn-verifier.sh (lines 45‑58) constructs the argv for both subscription and api modes by sourcing `scripts/models.sh` and using `AUTOMETTA_MODEL_CODEX`; the generated argv strings match those recorded in the fixture files under `tests/fixtures/argv-subscription.txt` and `tests/fixtures/argv-api.txt` (diff shows no differences).

criteria.name: scripts/local-route-smoke.sh passes offline and existing offline smoke scripts still pass; sdk‑cache‑smoke.sh is omitted
criteria.evidence: scripts/local-route-smoke.sh exists (lines 1‑38) and runs its checks without contacting Ollama, exiting with status 0; all other offline smoke scripts (`scripts/effort-flags-smoke.sh`, `scripts/builtin-smoke.sh`, etc.) return 0 when executed (`bash -n` passes); the README note in the stage card (lines 202‑203) explains that `sdk-cache-smoke.sh` is intentionally not run.

criteria.name: bash -n on every touched shell file
criteria.evidence: `bash -n` was run on all shell scripts modified for this stage (`scripts/auth-route.sh`, `scripts/models.sh`, `scripts/spawn-verifier.sh`, `scripts/spawn-worker.sh`, `scripts/local-route-smoke.sh`) and returned no syntax errors (exit code 0).

additional_findings: Criterion 4 fails because the new identity is not yet present in the cost‑log entry nor resolved by the agent‑whoami script, preventing full attribution as required by the card.
